name: SendZBC
description: Send ZBC from the sender to a recipient; optionally escrowed.

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

params.name: recipient
params.help: recipient address (ZBC_, 64 hex, or another chain's address)

notes: zbc-send also accepts --liquid <minutes>, which makes it a LiquidPayment (type 6) instead.
